external_collaboration.evidence_quote: In the last week of August, the Faculty of Environmental Protection hosted, in the framework of the Erasmus+ mobility training programme, assoc. prof. dr. Aniela Pop and prof. univ. dr. ing, Florica Manea from the partner Faculty of Industrial Chemistry and Environmental Engineering, Politechnica University Timisoara, Romania.
